about: Based in Randolph, Wisconsin, Barn & Beam Handcrafted Tables operates a showroom and workshop at 139 Stark Street. The company produces a line of dining tables, benches, chairs, stools, and table bases crafted from reclaimed barn beams and hand-welded metal. Products include trestle tables, X-base iron rail tables, and pedestal tables, all built to order. Barn & Beam sells directly to consumers through its appointment-only showroom and website, offering free in-home delivery within Wisconsin and a 20 percent discount for in-store pickup. Its customer base includes homeowners and interior designers seeking custom reclaimed-wood furniture. The business emphasizes handcrafted construction, using reclaimed materials and hand-welded metal bases, and operates by appointment to provide personalized service.
